purpose: Verified contract for prioritizing targeted re-verification of published property answers.
core_principle: PRIORITY FOLLOWS MATERIAL IMPACT; PRIORITY DOES NOT ESTABLISH LEGAL CORRECTNESS.
currentness_rule: Current answers are rechecked when material current records or sources change.
historical_rule: Historical answers remain anchored to their target date and are rechecked only when dependencies relevant to that historical state are affected.
deadline_rule: Deadline changes are escalated when the affected answer depends on the changed deadline or trigger rule.
queue_rule: Every queued item records why it was queued and which dependency caused the review.
closure_rule: A queue item closes only after re-verification, documented no-change determination, revised snapshot, or an explicitly recorded blocking state.
verification_boundary: The priority engine organizes work; it does not determine whether the underlying legal answer is correct.
